notes.title: Patch 1.4.6
notes.content:
FOUNTAINS Patch Notes - Release 1.4.6 (March 30th, 2025)

Hi FOUNTAINS players, this is just a small patch to tweak some issues players have found over the past few weeks.
Please note that patch notes can contain spoilers, read at your own risk.

Features:
- Can now press the "Back" button to cancel equipping a quick item or tool.
- Added a new set of armor to the game which was intended for release, but forgotten.

Tweaks:
- Tweaks to Japanese translation
- Reduced the amount of water gained from hits while slash-dashing

Fixes:
- Fixed a bug where Elias could become stuck
- Fixed a bug where Elias's altar animation could be interrupted
- Fixed the player having too long of a grace period after the boss died where they could not died
- Fixed a bug where Amtarr's music could stop mid-fight

FOUNTAINS Patch Notes - Release 1.4.0 (Feb 8th, 2025)

Hey again, FOUNTAINS players! This patch, the game finally supports achievements!
Please note that patch notes can contain spoilers, read at your own risk.

- 36 new achievements! Some related to in-game progress, some additional challenges

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.content:
FOUNTAINS Patch Notes - Release 1.3.1 (Jan 27 2025)

Hello, FOUNTAINS players!
こんにちは、私のゲームをこれからプレイするプレイヤーの皆さん！

This patch, the biggest change is support for Japanese!
Thanks go out to Kurono Studios for their work on this translation.
Please note that patch notes may contain spoilers; read at your own risk.

Features:
- Full support for the Japanese language

Fixes:
- Fixed Amtarr not always taking fully reduced damage when starting his second phase
- Fixed a bug where you could obtain a life fragment earlier than intended
- Fixed a softlock in Tide Fields
- Fixed being able to leave Rhamos' boss room while the fight is ongoing
- Fixed a visual bug when riding the ferry
- Fixed a stuck spot in Tide Fields
- Made it less likely to get stuck in Krus's fight
- Fixed Russian having no crowdfunding credits

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
FOUNTAINS Patch Notes - Release 1.2.0 (Dec 24 2024)

本次更新为游戏添加了中文！

Merry Christmas! This patch, the biggest change is full support for Simplified Chinese.
This makes FOUNTAINS accessible to 1.3 billion more players. Huge thanks go to Huang "Shuyuan" Teng for his amazing (and fast!) work on the Chinese translation.
Please note that patch notes may contain spoilers; read at your own risk.

Features:
- Full support for Chinese (Simplified Chinese translation by Huang "Shuyuan" Teng)

Tweaks:
- Minor level design tweak to make it more likely for players to find Guard Dog

Fixes:
- Fixed some bosses being attackable before their fight starts
- Fixed some issues with music timing in boss fights
- Fixed Ricard appearing too early near the temple
- Fixed pets spamming smoke particles if the player is teleported away
- Fixed a visual bug in Retreat of the Old Believers

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Release 1.1.1 (Dec 21 2024)
Please note that patch notes may contain spoilers! Read at your own risk.

Features:
- All bosses now grant some kind of Tool
- Consequently, some Tools have been moved from their original location.
    If you didn't pick them up before, you can go to the room of the defeated boss to pick them up.
    (don't worry, none of these are required to beat the game)
- There are now two bosses which can grant you a free tool slot upgrade

Tweaks:
- Guard Knights have more readable animations
- Updated some dialogue in Russian and Turkish
- Blessing of Amtarr bothers you much less frequently

Fixes:
- Fixed rare bug where you would fall off a cliff while dashing
- Fixed Ricard's quest ending before Krus is killed
- Fixed being able to activate a specific door while you're standing on it
- Fixed performance issue with flamethrowers on low-end machines

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
The second patch of the demo is here! This patch adds a world map system, more music tracks, a lot of bugfixes, and more secret content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791865/c939d36ee5f28fb82f1dbed6a49c6f33a6314b12.png[/img]

[b]FOUNTAINS Demo 1.3 Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Features:[/b]
    - World Map System 
        (To open, press X on keyboard, or down on the D-Pad)
    - New music for Guard Dog boss fight (Thanks, Travis Moberg!)
    - New music for Overgrown Church area (Again, thanks to Travis Moberg)


[b]Tweaks:[/b]
    - Buffed Guard Dog boss's melee damage
    - Red Mushroom now heals less, and more slowly.
    - Sprinting is faster
    - Toned down Doyle's dialect a bit


[b]Fixes:[/b]
    - Fix a stuck spot in Palace Garden under some banners
    - Fixed a typo in Sacha's dialogue
    - Fixed a possible sequence break: getting to Library before beating Hookmaster
    - Fixed being able to catch fish through a wooden bridge
    - Fixed unnecessarily nagging the player about no energy even if they didn't try to use energy
    - Fixed grapple-able wheat which would let you grapple to an island that wasn't supposed to be reached in the demo
    - Fixed Miners being permanently killable

[b]... and even more *secret changes*![/b]

By the way - the game's Kickstarter is now at 84% funding with ten days to go! Thanks so much to everyone who has contributed to the development of a full version of FOUNTAINS, we're almost there!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/johnpywell/fountains-action-rpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791865/c77e340650ee561407184a3379236932147a3b7a.png[/img][/url]

- Fixed Miners being permanently killable

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
As promised, the first demo patch is here! The most important change here is sprinting, so when you're lost in the world of FOUNTAINS it won't take quite so long to find your way! There are tons of other bugfixes, tweaks and minor changes as well. I'd also like to thank everyone who has funded the full version of FOUNTAINS on Kickstarter, we're making great progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791865/b11635bc4689a84c0659696fd5b6fc054fd59c9a.gif[/img]

FOUNTAINS Demo 1.2 Patch Notes

Features:

- Added sprinting (Hold L2 on controller, shift on keyboard)

- Added tutorial for movement and sprinting

- Added dog petting animation

- Added counter for how many dogs you've pet

- Added ability to skip opening messages (Godot logo, controller recommendation)

- Added ability to turn down or disable screen shake

- Added brightness and contrast settings

Tweaks:

- Tall grass can now be walked through

- Crates and barrels can be broken by rolling

- Buffed a lot of enemies' speed to compensate for sprinting being added

- Sword Guard and Spear Guard enemies now attack much more frequently

- Slightly lowered water gained from hitting normal enemies

- Added more flamethrowers in tutorial

- Shortened opening cutscene text

- Made roll go slightly further

Fixes:

- Roll will no longer go in the wrong direction after attacking while using keyboard direction controls

- Quick item count now properly updates after picking up more of the item

- Fixed various stuck spots and out of bounds glitches

... and some *secret changes*!
